content:
**Lakeside Cabins** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. It is a Public Workshop with claim and defend event quests.

These old rentable cabins once provided a stunning view of the Summersville reservoir. Now they are just derelicts, sitting on the edge of the half-dry reservoir, emptied after the destruction of the Summersville Dam in 2082.

The lake area consists of four cabins and a trailer along the northwest bank of Summersville Lake. Each cabin has a number assigned to it, with cabin number four being the northernmost and cabin number one the southernmost. There is a dock that once led into the lake, although only two cabins are part of the marked Workshop area. A Tinker's Workbench is on the back deck of the middle cabin.

Inside the two-story building next to the workshop, is a refrigerator containing a Pumpkin Pie that doesn't spoil and on the back deck is a Chemistry Station. There is also a small garden near the workshop, containing Mutfruit and Silt Bean plants.

As a Workshop, the area offers the following resources: Food (6), Water (6), Silver (1), Crystal (1), Lead (1), Wood (1). There is also a Poseidon Power box by the southwestern entrance, which temporarily provides 100 units of power if the Powering Up Poseidon event has been completed. The build area stretches across the two southwestern cabins, bordered by the fences.

Lakeside Cabins appears in *Fallout 76*.
